description: Opus BB unit B24: Utility Umbrella's End on a Flower Gift holder in (patched) sun. Choice Scarf Weavile Tricks the umbrella away from Cherrim: the End's WeatherChange turns it into Cherrim-Sunshine. Mold Breaker Excadrill's Trick takes the umbrella of the other Cherrim (Bloom): the move ignores abilities, so `runEvent('WeatherChange')` skips the breakable Flower Gift and Bloom stays Cherrim. Each Cherrim gets the Choice item (its Start removes a `choicelock`).
